lines.trans: Relax, my friend, do not be so nervous.
He simply wants to get a rise out of me.
Do not take offense at my words.
What do you want to tell me?
She would never choose you.
Why are you so confident about this?
She is a beautiful and mature woman.
And you are simply a broke young cook.
I know her from a completely different side.
Do you want to drink some juice with me?
No, thank you, I am at work right now.
Well, suit yourself, it is your business.
I will still talk with her anyway.

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.

взрослый.gloss: adult, grown-up; (as a noun) a grown-up

meanings.note: as a noun, often plural: взрослые = grown-ups

meanings.en: to choose, select; to use up completely (quotas, limits)

examples.text: В этом году все квоты выбрали.
examples.trans: This year all the quotas have been used up.
She chose the most beautiful dress.

выпить.gloss: to drink, to have a drink

meanings.en: to drink up, to have a drink
meanings.note: often used without an object for drinking alcohol

examples.trans: Oh, I've had a bit to drink now.

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: They have a very beautiful house.

examples.text: Молодой человек, как на тест-драйв записаться?
examples.trans: Young man, how do I sign up for a test drive?
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: Don't be nervous, everything is fine.

meanings.note: used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

обижаться.gloss: to take offence, to be hurt

meanings.en: to take offence, to get upset

examples.trans: Don't be offended by my words.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)
to have a talk, to speak (with someone)

позлить.gloss: to anger, to tease, to annoy

examples.text: Он просто хотел немного позлить своего друга.
examples.trans: He simply wanted to tease his friend a little.
Why are we going so slowly?

meanings.note: almost always in 'всё равно' = it doesn't matter; мне всё равно = I don't care
+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
'дать слово' = to give one's word, 'держать слово' = to keep one's word

собираться.gloss: to intend, to be about to; to gather

meanings.en: to intend, to plan, to be going to

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for
с другой стороны = on the other hand

examples.trans: On the other hand, it's interesting.
The shop is on that side.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.text: Что-то голос какой-то не очень уверенный.
examples.trans: Your voice doesn't sound very confident.
He answered in a calm, confident voice.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
